items.title: The Knicks have been in touch with Jeremy Sochan’s team and plan on honoring him at a home game at the appropriate time, hopefully with him amidst an NBA return, source said. He played sparingly for NY last season and is now with the G League Texas Legends tinyurl.com/44pzm8ry

media.title: Jeremy Sochan betting on himself to get back to NBA - Andscape
media.description: Jeremy Sochan, the No. 1 pick in this year's G League draft, is looking for a fresh start with the Mavericks affiliate Texas Legends.
